heading_en: Application for Approval of the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式の承認申請書の記載事項と、添付書類(特定の手法・調整を用いる場合の参考書類を含む。)を定める。
summary_en: Sets the contents of the application for approval of the internal model approach and its attachments, including reference documents where certain methods or adjustments are used.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under the preceding Article for the use of the internal model approach shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for understanding and managing the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval under the preceding paragraph. (i) A statement of reasons. (ii) A curriculum vitae of the person responsible prescribed in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (iii) A document showing conformity with the standards for approval of the internal model approach prescribed in the following Article. (iv) Where any of the following cases applies, a document stating the matters that should be used for reference in each case. (a) Where the method listed in Article 252-4, paragraph (1), item (i) is used. (b) Where the method prescribed in Article 252-5, paragraph (2), item (i)(b) is used. (c) Where market risk-related valuation adjustments are deducted from the actual profits and losses prescribed in Article 253-5, paragraph (4). (d) Where market risk-related valuation adjustments are deducted from the hypothetical profits and losses prescribed in Article 253-5, paragraph (5). (e) Where the input data for the risk-theoretical profits and losses prescribed in Article 253-6, paragraph (1) is adjusted. (f) Where the level of the liquidity horizon n prescribed in Article 254-2, paragraph (3) is adjusted. (g) Where the reduced set of risk factors prescribed in Article 254-3, paragraph (1) is used. (h) Where the simplified model prescribed in Article 255, paragraph (3), item (xviii) is used. (i) Where the market price-based PD prescribed in Article 255, paragraph (3), item (xix)(a) is used. (v) A document stating other matters that should be used for reference in the examination for approval.
